description: He wears a cream long linen tunic with purple-and-gold geometric neckline, front and cuff details beneath a plum-purple noble outer coat with broad gold-tan floral/geometric edging and wide sleeves. A matching shoulder drape crosses the torso from a small round jeweled brooch. A decorated dark belt closes with a large worked round clasp and hanging metal ornaments. Dark trousers and tall brown leather boots are visible. No headgear, armor or weapons appear.
